_source: https://www.bg-wiki.com/ffxi/CatsEyeXI_Commands (checked 2026-10-18). Server commands are sent as /say !name. Add a new command as one line here.

info.currency: Dynamis, Alexandrite, H-P Bayld and Incursion currency and where it is
info.incursion: Occupied Incursion areas and time left
info.keys: Chest and coffer keys stored with Picklox
info.lsstats: Top linkshell Summit contributors (add a number)
info.maat: Jobs you used to beat Maat
info.mog: Opens the Mog House menu (cities only)
info.pass: Garrison pop items stored with Picklox
info.points: Currency, Venture and Crystal Warrior points
info.pops: NMs and bosses you can spawn now
info.rifts: When and where a Rift opened
info.rubyweather: Unlocked weathers for the SMN quest
info.scroll: Check if a scroll is stored (add the scroll name)
info.summitcalc: Break down adjusted Summit points (add an amount)
info.vault: Opens your Mog Vault (towns) or shows quest progress
info.wspoints: Weapon skill points (main, sub or ranged)

_not_included: !campaign and !squire are on the BG-Wiki page but left out for now. Adding them changes what can be sent, so they wait for a staff review.
_modes: Game modes (ace, cw, wew) for commands that don't work in every mode. Leave a command out if it works in all three. Shown as icons and used by the mode filter on the phone. It doesn't change what can be sent.

action.box: Check, withdraw or store items in the Ephemeral Box
action.chef: Buy a food item with gil
action.config: Change a CatsEye option (name and value)
action.dawnunstuck: Free yourself from the CoP 8-4 Dawn stuck event
action.skipfloor: Skip a Nyzul lamp floor (party-wide, every 30 min)
action.summit: Check or toggle your Summit contribution
action.summitreward: Pick the linkshell Summit reward (owner only)

_emotes_source: Stock FFXI emotes (list from horizonffxi.wiki/Command, retail-derived). Sent as /name, /name motion (animation only) or /name text (text only). /sitchair takes 1-4, /jobemote takes a job. Not yet checked against CatsEye.
